description.en: The IEC 60320 C8 appliance inlet: a two-pin, 2.5 A, class II mains inlet whose figure-eight recess (16.5 × 8.2 mm inside) takes a C7 connector. Many consoles' power inlets are one.
description.es: La entrada de aparato IEC 60320 C8: una entrada de red de dos pines, 2.5 A y clase II cuyo hueco en forma de ocho (16.5 × 8.2 mm por dentro) recibe un conector C7. La entrada de alimentación de muchas consolas es una.
description.fr: Le socle de connecteur CEI 60320 C8 : une entrée secteur à deux broches, 2,5 A, classe II, dont le logement en huit (16,5 × 8,2 mm à l'intérieur) reçoit un connecteur C7. L'entrée d'alimentation de nombreuses consoles en est un.
description.pt: A entrada de aparelho IEC 60320 C8: uma entrada de rede de dois pinos, 2,5 A e classe II cujo rebaixo em forma de oito (16,5 × 8,2 mm por dentro) recebe um conector C7. A entrada de alimentação de muitas consolas é uma.

sources.title: Qualtek 771W-X2/01 AC receptacle (IEC 60320 C8 snap-in inlet), drawing rev F (2009-04-28)
sources.supports: flange 28.3 × 16 ±0.3, R2 corners, 3.0 ±0.2 thick; recess (inside) 16.5 × 8.2 +0.8/0 with a 60° waist; two pins Ø2.36 ±0.04 at 8.6 ±0.15 pitch; panel cut-out a cross: 19.5 × 12.5 centre with side lobes to 24.5 over a 7.5 band, ±0.1; panel 0.6–1.5; 2.5 A 250 V AC

sources.title: Qualtek product pages 771W-X2/01, 701W-X2/04 and 703W-00/03
sources.supports: 771W-X2/01: IEC 60320 C8 low-current inlet; 701W-X2/04: IEC 60320 C14 universal snap-in AC power inlet; 703W-00/03: IEC 60320 C14 non-countersunk screw mount

sources.title: Schurter 2578 IEC appliance inlet C8, snap-in, front side, datasheet (2015-04-29)
sources.supports: appliance inlet C8 according to IEC 60320; IEC 2.5 A / 250 VAC 50 Hz; protection class II; line and neutral contacts; front flange 27.2 × 16, 3 thick; cut-out 24.1 × 11.7 +0.20/0 for a 1.5–3.0 panel

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the recess on the inlet's front (mating) face, the flange's face. +z points out of the opening, toward a plug; +x runs along the opening's width; +y = z × x runs along its height. The body behind the face lies at z < 0.

recess_width.note: inside, along the line of the pins

pins.note: line and neutral, protection class II

panel_cutout_lobe_height.note: the band the side lobes span

interfaces.note: Female: a C7 connector's nose enters the recess and takes the two pins. Symmetry 2: the plain figure-eight outline and the two pins both makers draw are the same after a half-turn (the polarised C7P/C8P variant is not this part).

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: IEC 60320 is not freely published, so the facts are one inlet's drawing (Qualtek 771W, snap-in), with Schurter's 2578 confirming the designation, the rating and the class. The panel cut-out is this part's: Schurter's snap-in 2578 asks for 24.1 × 11.7 and screw-on inlets differ again. The C7 connector's face is not sourced, so it has no entry yet.
